scenes.text: This tutorial covers External Masks. Turn third-party label masks and source images into a measured, traceable spaCR project.
Open External Masks from the Data and batch runs section. Provide source images, external masks, naming rules, object types, and optional measurement tables.
In the main configuration area, map images to masks, validate shape and label conventions, choose relabeling, and define measurement options.
Before the full run, review the visible settings and use a preview or test mode when one is available. preview alignment and object counts on several fields before importing the complete dataset.
When the workflow finishes, spaCR stores normalized masks, mapped images, measurements, and provenance ready for annotation.
